result.summary: The screen renders cleanly overall. Edge-clipped carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behavior and not defects. The only clear visual problem is an inconsistent favorite-button treatment between the two large cards.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the favorite heart control renders inconsistently: on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card it is a bare outline with no visible button background, while on the card directly below the same heart sits inside a dark circular button. The same control therefore looks like two different elements, and the bare heart is harder to recognize as a tappable button against the photo.
issues.suggestion: Apply one consistent favorite-button style to all large cards, such as a heart centered in a circular translucent backdrop, so the control is uniformly recognizable and remains visible on any image.
